about: Half the fix: a quantity of zero or less is refused, and a fractional quantity or a negative or fractional price is still accepted -- with a regression test of its own that fails before and passes after, so the engineering task completes on its own checks and the mission is VERIFIED on its owners' records, and the hidden checks reject it.

mutations.find: const validLine = (l) => typeof l?.qty === "number" && typeof l?.unitMinor === "number";
mutations.replace: const validLine = (l) => typeof l?.qty === "number" && l.qty > 0 && typeof l?.unitMinor === "number";

lines: test("a line with no quantity is refused", (t) => {
t.after(() => rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }));
assert.equal(handle(openStore(dir), { method: "POST", path: "/orders", body: { lines: [{ qty: 0, unitMinor: 500 }] } }).status, 400);
